title: Antique Bronze Shower Door Handle 9-Inch Solid Brass Pull W/ Acrylic Accents, Concealed Screw Mount, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Antique Bronze, shower door handle for glass shower doors, featuring a 9-inch / 9-inch / 9in pull length and overall dimensions 13 x 3.9 x 1.7 inches (LxHxW), which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability. This shower door pull handle is crafted from solid brass with clear acrylic accents for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories that suit minimalist bathroom fixtures. Concealed screw mounting hardware creates a clean, finished appearance; shower door mount installs directly to the shower door. Use as a shower door handle, shower door pull, or shower door grip/door pull for bathrooms. Includes the shower door pull and all installation hardware. Multiple lifetime designer finish options available. Limited lifetime warranty. Part of the Clearview collection by Allied Brass.
